human_weight_instruction: Do both equal and market-cap weights across families. Retain proposed GDP weighting within families, and provide equal-country/market-cap within-family alternatives.
estimand: Family-specific group-time DiD followed by explicit nonnegative cohort/time aggregation within families and nonnegative aggregation across supported regulation families. A country-market policy-exposure estimand, separate from bank-issuer tests.
method: Unconditional panel group-time DID building blocks following Callaway/SantAnna. Separate regulation-family treatment G by country; not-yet-treated known controls only; no already-treated focal-family controls. No generic TWFE coefficient.
family_definition: 17economic regulation classes: combine BANK_PARTIAL/FULL as one bank-public-CbCR family using initial2014publicphase in primary. Full2015is a separate phase sensitivity, not an extra equally weighted family. Published ESG benchmark is separate, never counted twice.
primary_country_outcomes: Mean of annual screened security-level logspread,logimpact,zerofraction within country, with>=30validsecurityobservations for eachoutcome/year. Market composition may change and is explicitly checked in fixed-security sensitivity.
primary_summary: Equal average of e=0,1,2, requiring the same supported cohorts and countries for all five estimated pre/post event times. This prevents early-cohort overrepresentation and changing event-study support.
controls: For each cohort g, require known G>g+2, not missing-as-never. Bank nonEUhome geography controls remain explicitly subject to foreign-subsidiary exposure; EEAoutsideEUexcluded. Unknown other-law histories are not certified absent.
market_cap_definition: Sum sampled quote marketcaps in g-1 across supported treated country/cohort cells, once per family. Fixed across eventtimes. Across-family cap weights count repeated exposure to different laws and are not a unique-firm portfolio marketcap.
common_coverage: Primary cross-family comparison uses the same regulation-family set across all three primary outcomes and both requested across-family weights, conditional on within-family weight scheme. Additional available-family estimates disclosed separately. Unsupported families are listed, never entered as zero.
support: Point estimate requires at least1treated and3controlcountries in a cohort and complete annual countryoutcomes in g-3..g+2. Inference flags fewer than5treated or5controlcountries/clusters and singlecollectivewave designs; no false policy-replication claim.
inference: Country-cluster influence-function multiplier draws shared across all cohort/family/outcome cells to preserve repeated-country covariance.1999Rademacher draws,fixedseed20261019. Report pointwiseSE/95CI and joint max-t eventprofile bands; also conservative EU-as-one-block diagnostics with explicit single-treated-block flag. These are conditional market-sampling diagnostics, not proof of exogenous regulation or independent national policy choices.
pretrends: Report leads e=-3,-2, joint bootstrap pretrend diagnostic and simultaneous bands. Do not drop or select families according to pretest p-values.
bank_issuer_protocol: Map historical EBAgroup identities and public entity/ISIN evidence to major primary Datastream equities. Keep direct institution vs listed parent vs subsidiary distinct, de-duplicate group/ISIN/shareclasses. Exact identifier and dated-source-confirmed links separated from current-only/fuzzy candidates. No fuzzy match auto-promoted. Record actual publication dates only with primary dated evidence; statutory deadlines/reportperiod ends remain separate.
bank_issuer_design: Annual issuer-level home-regime exposure DID with verified matched banking groups and separately documented nonEUbank comparison issuers; foreignEUsubsidiary spillovers flagged. Additional first-observed-public-filing timing estimates only for issuers with evidenced dates and sufficient not-yet/othercontrol support. Unresolved issuer/date rows remain in an explicit disposition table, not fabricated.
selection: All supported families, requested weights, contrary results, unsupported designs, failed fits and match dispositions retained. Main paper concerns all-regulation aggregation; banking is a separate issuer-level application.
legal_scope_limits: Country phases are not universal issuer eligibility or a certified first-ever E/S/G topic census. Simultaneous other regulations can confound individual law effects. No causal claim without credible paralleltrends/noanticipation/nointerference assumptions.

coverage_amendment.reason: The human requests all regulation families. Requiring three earlier years and two later years excludes laws solely because of panel boundaries. Add first-year group-timeDID with just g-1/g support as an explicitly broader endpoint, retaining the frozen balanced0..2 design and its event/pretrend diagnostics. No sign/significance-based inclusion.
coverage_amendment.comparison: Family coverage differs across endpoints; never imply a horizon difference is only a dynamic effect. Unsupported families still listed, never zero.
